subject.title: refactor(prompt): use plain inbound context labels and drop system-tag sanitizer

question: Should OpenClaw accept this coordinated trust-boundary and persisted-state migration—plain marked context labels, narrowed system-event neutralization, Doctor transcript rewriting, and legacy LanceDB deletion—as the supported upgrade path?
rationale: This is not a mechanical correctness choice: it intentionally changes the public plugin SDK vocabulary, prompt-context representation, cleanup behavior for stored memory rows, and the security boundary used to distinguish injected context from user text.

options.title: Approve the coordinated migration
options.body: Accept the marker-based context contract and Doctor-only repairs after the branch is refreshed against current main and maintainers are satisfied with the stated deletion and collision tradeoffs.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only the marker and runtime-path refactor, then track SDK renames or persisted-state repair as separately reviewed compatibility work.

options.title: Keep current labels and sanitizer
options.body: Reject the migration if maintainers want trust wording or the broader sanitizer to remain part of the supported prompt-boundary contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the coordinated migration
recommendation.body: Accept the marker-based context contract and Doctor-only repairs after the branch is refreshed against current main and maintainers are satisfied with the stated deletion and collision tradeoffs.
